limits: Mixed WaW/BO2/Minecraft supplied models: classic BO2-inspired effects, not an exact port of one Call of Duty release.
Three usable perk flavours with drinking animations; all five supplied bottles displayed. PHD and Quick Revive bottles are props; no new revive or self-explosion system.
Three base hits preserved per user instruction; Jugger raises them to five. Custom bosses take bounded electrical damage rather than unconditional instant death.
Single weapon inventory preserved. Unclaimed Pack reward is lost; fallback USP45. No repeat Pack attachments or power-switch quest.
Gamepads were browser-mapped simulations; no physical-controller session. No fresh FPS benchmark.
